name: gdx-skill-create-spu-agent
description: Guides creation/verification of the Neo4j Aura Agent for the GDX_HUMAN7 knowledge graph -- checks the target Aura instance is reachable, then walks through the Name/Description/Prompt instruction/sharing scope to use (reusing the exact prompt from 11.gdx.llm.agent.mcp/prompt.instruction.txt), since Aura has no management API to create or read back an Agent's configuration.
